## Email — cold sender

Every 10 minutes, calls the app's cold sending run on Vercel: `GET $APP_BASE_URL/api/email/cold-tick` with `Bearer $CRON_SECRET`.

The run itself decides everything (src/lib/email/cold.js): it sends only Sunday–Thursday 09:00–17:00 Riyadh, at most ONE email per outreach mailbox per call, within each mailbox's ramp and daily limit, and only for workspaces whose cold switch is on (Email → Settings). Outside those hours a call returns at once and sends nothing, so this schedule does not need to know them.

**Never add retryOnFail to the HTTP node.** A retry of a call whose email already left would be refused by the row claim, but there is nothing to gain.

Needs on the box: `CRON_SECRET` in n8n/docker/.env (the same value as on Vercel), and `APP_BASE_URL` (set in docker-compose.yml).

nodes.name: GET /api/email/cold-tick
nodes.notes: Sends real email. No retryOnFail on purpose.
